spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (तिम्यति)
To be or become wet, damp, &c.

m. (-मः)
A fish: see the next.

r. 4th cl. (तीम्यति)
To be wet or moist: see तिम.

m. (-मिः)
1 A whale, or a fabulous fish of an enormous size, said to be one hundred Yojanas long.
2 The ocean.
E.
तम to distress, इन् affix, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; otherwise तिम to be wet or watery, affix कि, or with क affix तिम.

m. (-षः)
The ocean.
E.
तिमि a fish, as above, and कोष receptacle: also तिमिकोषक.

m. (-लः)
A large fabulous fish: see तिमि.
E.
तिमि the fish so called, and गिल who swallows, (from गॄ with क affix, र changed to ल) and मुम् augment.

m. (-लः)
A fabulous fish larger than either of the preceding: see तिमि and तिमिंगिल.
E.
तिमिङ्गिल the fish so called, and गिल who devours.

mn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wet, moist, moistened, damp.
2 Steady, fixed, unmoved, unshaken.
E.
तिम to be wet or damp, affix क्त.

Gutta serena, total blindness from affection of the optic nerve.
E.
तिम to be damp, or तम to give pain, किरच् Uṇādi affix, in the latter case इत् is inserted.

m. (-पुः)
The sun.
E.
तिमिर darkness, and रिपु an enemy.

n. (-षः)
1 A kind of pumpkin gourd: see ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी.
2 A watermelon.
E.
तम to desire or be desired, इषच् affix, इत् inserted.
